adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `addGuestsHandler` authorization logic, attendee status is computed via an exact string comparison: `const isAttendee = !!booking.attendees.find((attendee) => attendee.email === user.email);` (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts). Neither side is normalized (e.g., lowercased/trimmed), so a case difference between the stored attendee email and `user.email` can incorrectly make `isAttendee` false, causing a legitimate attendee to hit the `FORBIDDEN` path.
